name: AgentX Micro-Services
description: Twelve pay-per-call agent micro-services via x402 (USDC on Base + Solana): weather, site health, x402 Doctor spec-check, SEO audit, site agent-readiness verdict card, A2A/MCP protocol card lint, AI-crawler + security policy card, WebMCP check, WebMCP upgrade, AI topic classification, AI keyword extraction, New Landing Page Roast. Streamable-HTTP MCP with a free catalogue and x402 Doctor. Catalogue: https://agentx.sale/x402/catalogue

skills.name: Weather
skills.description: Live current weather for any city. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/weather?city=<city> ($0.01)

skills.name: Site Health
skills.description: DNS, TLS certificate, HTTP status and latency snapshot for a domain. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/site-health?host=<domain> ($0.01)

skills.name: x402 Doctor
skills.description: Is a URL a valid agent-payable x402 resource? v1+v2 spec check with grade. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/x402-check?url=<url> ($0.02)

skills.name: SEO Audit
skills.description: Rules-based SEO and agent-readiness audit of a domain. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/seo-audit?host=<domain> ($0.10)

skills.name: Agent-Readiness Card
skills.description: Site agent-readiness verdict card: discovery files, TLS, headers, AI-crawler policy. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/agent-card?host=<domain> ($0.02)

skills.name: Protocol Card Lint
skills.description: A2A / MCP protocol card lint with drop-in patched JSON fixes. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/protocol-lint?url=<domain> ($0.02)

skills.name: AI Crawler Policy Card
skills.description: TLS, security headers and AI-crawler policy matrix for a domain. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/crawler-policy?host=<domain> ($0.02)

skills.name: WebMCP Check
skills.description: WebMCP agent-compatibility check with inventory and readiness verdict. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/webmcp-check?host=<domain> ($0.10)

skills.name: WebMCP Upgrade
skills.description: Generated webmcp.js tool file with publish instructions. POST https://agentx.sale/x402/webmcp-upgrade ($4.00)

skills.name: AI Topic Classification
skills.description: Classify supplied text: free-form topics or caller-supplied label set, confidence + rationale. POST https://agentx.sale/x402/classify ($1.75)

skills.name: AI Keyword Extraction
skills.description: Top salient keywords and key phrases with scores, language detected. POST https://agentx.sale/x402/keywords ($0.90)

skills.name: New Landing Page Roast
skills.description: Five persona critiques of a landing page offer, focus and durability, plus a shareable SVG card. GET https://agentx.sale/x402/gtm-roast?url=<url> or POST {url} ($0.02)
